instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium shot captures a park pathway. On the left, the man in the plaid shirt (R1) walks forward with a gentle smile, a bright lens flare shining near his head. On the right, the woman in the dark blue shirt (R2) walks beside him, looking down with a joyful smile. They stroll side-by-side through the sun-drenched park, surrounded by lush green trees and soft shadows.
